query: What storage solutions are recommended for AI data centers, and which Chinese vendors are notable?
response:
For AI data centers—characterized by massive unstructured data (e.g., images, videos, text corpora), high-throughput I/O, low-latency access for training/inference, and scalable metadata management—the ideal storage solutions must balance performance, scalability, cost-efficiency, and AI-aware features (e.g., object-to-POSIX bridging, GPU-direct storage support, intelligent tiering, and integration with ML frameworks like PyTorch/TensorFlow). Here's a breakdown: ### ✅ Recommended Storage Architectures & Technologies | Category | Key Solutions | Why Suitable for AI | |----------|----------------|---------------------| | **High-Performance Parallel File Systems** | Lustre (with DAOS or ZFS backends), WekaFS, VAST Data, DDN EXAScaler | Deliver 100+ GB/s throughput, sub-100μs latency, POSIX semantics for distributed training; support RDMA/GPU-Direct Storage (GDS) for zero-copy GPU access. | | **AI-Optimized Object Storage + Acceleration Layer** | MinIO (with NVMe caching & S3-compatible API), Ceph (with BlueStore + NVMe journals), Cloudian HyperStore | Cost-effective petabyte-scale capacity; enhanced with intelligent caching (e.g., MinIO’s erasure coding + tiered cache), S3-to-POSIX bridges (e.g., s3fs, JuiceFS), and built-in data versioning/labeling. | | **Unified/Converged Storage Platforms** | Pure Storage FlashBlade//S (with DirectFlash shelf + Unified Acceleration), NetApp AFF A800 + ONTAP AI | Single-stack for file/object/block; native AI workload profiling, automated tiering (hot/cold data), integrated data protection, and certified stacks for NVIDIA AI Enterprise. | | **Emerging: Computational Storage & AI-Native File Systems** | Lightbits Labs (NVMe-oF + computational storage), TileDB (array-native, columnar + sparse tensor support), LakeFS (for ML data versioning on object stores) | Offload preprocessing/filtering to storage layer; native support for tensors, time-series, geospatial data; Git-like versioning for datasets & models. | ### 🇨🇳 Notable Chinese Vendors (with AI Data Center Focus) | Vendor | Key Products | AI-Relevant Strengths | Notes | |--------|--------------|------------------------|-------| | **Inspur (Inspur Information)** | AS13000, iStor AI Storage Platform | • Optimized for large-scale AI training clusters (supports >10K GPUs)
